simple.meaning: קִרְיַת בַּעַל (Qiryath Baʻal) is a place-name in the Hebrew text (H7154). BibleIQ follows its 2 occurrences across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This place appears in Joshua, beginning at Joshua 15:60. The surrounding context includes city, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to the Hebrew place-name קִרְיַת בַּעַל (H7154).
simple.whyItMatters: Places in Scripture often connect geography, covenant history, judgment, worship, and movement through the land. BibleIQ keeps the place tied to its actual verse trail.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

majorEvents.label: Movement or place
majorEvents.evidenceText: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.
